boundary: Scope: Tekmerion study records on the Axiomere record layer (DN-007)
Excludes external anchor transport (Axiomere layer 5, Phase 5 / AR-1)

evidence.ref: AXIOVEX/axiomere crates/axiomere/src/lib.rs (no update/delete in API); 7 integration tests incl. seeded tamper/deletion/forgery
tekmerion.store.StudyStore + tests/test_store_axiomere.py (dead semantics verified against the real core)

falsification_tests: F-002-D1a: any code path in the record layer or framework that mutates a stored event in place.
claims.text: The record layer is append-only: events are hash-chained and Ed25519-signed, and no API operation in the record layer or the framework mutates a stored event.

boundary: Scope: Crossref and OpenAlex connectors (Spec 002 Phase 2)
Excludes sources without verified public APIs (WS1 registry)

evidence.ref: src/tekmerion/connectors.py (license_basis mandatory on RetrievedItem; abstract-drop rule)
Live verification 2026-10-11: Crossref search/resolve roundtrip; NC-licensed item flagged hosted_ok=False

falsification_tests: F-002-D2: a retrieved item in a study record with an empty/defaulted license_basis, or an unlicensed abstract present in claim evidence.
claims.text: Every connector-retrieved item carries a per-record license_basis, and material without an asserted licence is not treated as reusable (Crossref abstracts without a licence are dropped).

boundary: Scope: OpenAlex calls issued through tekmerion.connectors
Unit costs are configuration; the budget relation (filter << search) is the verified part

evidence.ref: Live verification 2026-10-11 with the owner's key: filter search settled at cost_filter

falsification_tests: F-002-D3: an OpenAlex call issued without a prior reservation, or a run that continues after BudgetExhausted.
claims.text: OpenAlex access is budget-disciplined: calls reserve credits before they run (filter preferred at the verified ~10x cost relation) and exhaustion stops the run rather than overrunning.

boundary: Scope: claims registered through ClaimRegister
Draft (proposed) claims may be revised pre-freeze per WS2 lifecycle
falsification_tests: F-002-D4: a registered claim with an empty falsifier, or a post-registration statement edit that does not create a superseding claim.
claims.text: A claim cannot be registered without a falsifier, and claim statements are immutable after registration — a changed statement is a new claim that supersedes the old, with the link recorded.

boundary: Scope: within-study claim graph
Evidence-group dependencies (EVG-) are not graph nodes for cycle purposes
falsification_tests: F-002-D5: a frozen registration whose claim graph contains a cycle.
claims.text: Circular claim dependencies are rejected: the dependency graph is a DAG and the freeze check names any cycle as circular support.

boundary: Scope: runs evaluated through evaluate_run
Human adjudication overrides are separate appended records, not run verdicts
falsification_tests: F-002-D6: any run with a failed control or unverified citation that nevertheless carries a claim-level verdict.
claims.text: INVALID attaches to the run, not the claim: a control failure, unverified citation, chain break, or deviation from the frozen registration yields a run verdict of INVALID and zero claim verdicts.

boundary: Scope: verdicts from evaluate_claim under a registered margin and floor
Entrenchment rules for conflicting groups are not yet implemented (conflict falls to INCONCLUSIVE by interval straddle)

evidence.ref: src/tekmerion/verdicts.py evaluate_claim (could_falsify gate, interval margin test, sufficiency floor)

falsification_tests: F-002-D7: a SUPPORTED verdict issued for a claim whose evidence set contains no group that could have contradicted it, or whose interval straddles the margin.
claims.text: SUPPORTED requires exposure to refutation: the falsifier test must have been capable of firing and the interval of net support must clear the registered margin; otherwise the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.

boundary: Scope: the three registered control kinds (positive, negative, swap)
The swap control verifies a copy; the production ledger is never the tampered one

evidence.ref: tests/test_phase3.py::test_failing_control_invalidates_the_run (control exercised against the real ledger file)

falsification_tests: F-002-D8: a control evaluated by a code path that production verdicts or production verification do not use.
claims.text: Controls certify through the production paths: positive/negative controls are evaluated by the same evaluate_claim function real claims use, and the swap control requires the production Axiomere verifier to detect a provenance swap in a copy of the study ledger.

boundary: Scope: mode separation inside evaluate_run and freeze_check
Design-shopping beyond disclosure is a governance risk the engine records but cannot prevent (WS3 §4)

evidence.ref: src/tekmerion/verdicts.py evaluate_run (mode wall); src/tekmerion/freeze.py freeze_check (RT-3 disclosure)

falsification_tests: F-002-D9: a confirmation verdict whose registration lacks a freeze record or a linked-exploratory disclosure.
claims.text: Exploratory results cannot be promoted: a confirmation run without a frozen registration is INVALID, and a confirmation registration must disclose its linked exploratory studies (an explicit empty list is required, not an omission).

boundary: Scope: the Phase 7 frozen evaluation corpus
This is kill criterion K1 (DN-002): failure kills the MVP slice

evidence.ref: WS5 pipeline design (docs/architecture/05-trust-safety.md); Spec 002 Phase 4 (T214) not yet built
Spec 001 CLM-001-05 carries the same commitment at product level

falsification_tests: F-002-D10: the Phase 7 evaluation reports any fabricated or unresolvable citation in the frozen corpus (K1 fails; the MVP slice is killed per DN-002).
claims.text: The citation pipeline (existence, metadata agreement, content support) will drive fabricated or unsupported citations to zero in the evaluation corpus (kill criterion K1: 100% citation resolution).

boundary: Scope: Phase 5 export/anchor (not yet built)
Axiomere checkpoint roots exist today; bundle format and deposit actions do not

evidence.ref: WS4 §4 bundle format; Spec 002 Phase 5 (T216-T218) not yet built; Axiomere checkpoint roots implemented (AXIOVEX/axiomere)

falsification_tests: F-002-D11a: an exported bundle whose manifest fails standalone verification.
claims.text: A complete study run can be exported as an audit bundle whose manifest verifies standalone, using only the bundle and the log files it contains.

boundary: Scope: Axiomere dead semantics as consumed by StudyStore.withdraw
falsification_tests: F-002-D1b: a withdrawn record whose prior snapshots are not fully readable, or a dead record with score other than 0.0 or no reason.
claims.text: Withdrawal is a dead snapshot: status dead, a mandatory reason on the record, score forced to 0.0, and the record's full history remains readable.

boundary: Scope: Phase 5 anchor transport (not yet built)
Axiomere checkpoint roots exist today; anchor transport does not

evidence.ref: WS4 records/export design + Spec 002 gate G2/AR-1 (docs/architecture/04-records-export.md)

falsification_tests: F-002-D11b: a pilot started before the AR-1 anchor demonstration, or an anchor receipt missing from the study record.
claims.text: Before any pilot, a study checkpoint root will be deposited with an external anchor the operator does not control, and the deposit receipt will be part of the study record (AR-1 / gate G2).
